author: m. s. goins
title: FIU softball ranked 36th in first NCAA RPI rankings of 2026 season
text:
FIU’s softball team is ranked 36th in the first edition of the NCAA RPI Rankings for the 2026 season, according to a March 9 announcement from the program. The Panthers, who currently hold a record of 19-5, are experiencing what they describe as a historic start to their season.
The ranking places FIU at the top among Conference USA teams, with Western Kentucky trailing as the second-best in the conference at No. 62. Nationally among mid-major programs, FIU stands fourth behind McNeese (16), Grand Canyon (30), and Belmont (33).
This recognition comes after notable victories against several highly ranked opponents. FIU has defeated Georgia Tech, which is ranked 24th, twice this season. The team also secured a win over Marshall (41st) and two wins against Louisville (46th).
Looking ahead, FIU will host UTEP for its first Conference USA home series of the year from March 13 to March 15 at Baptist Health Stadium.
Fans can follow updates about the team on social media platforms including Instagram (@FIUSoftball), X (@FIUSoftball), and Facebook (Facebook.com/FIUSoftball).
